name: No Girl Left Behind
tagline: Every resident registers in every scene set in her home. No girl fades into the background without intention.
body: Before a house scene is marked complete, the roster is pulled, the scene is scanned paragraph by paragraph, a presence state is assigned to every girl, and any gap halts the scene until the missing girls are woven in naturally. Ghost Haven and Banshee Haven girls may visit a Specter Haven scene, but visitors never displace residents and never trigger the sweep on their own behalf.
rules: Speaking — at least one line, even a single murmured word
Existing — physically present and described in the scene
Interacting — engaged with another character through touch, reaction, gesture or laughter
Minimum: one state per resident, plus at least one interaction that is not with her own partner
Only Viraena may override, and the bypass is logged
